intro: 12 個薪資與福利情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: The new staff member wasn't aware of the company's position on working a second job.
ex.zh: 這位新進員工不知道公司對於兼差第二份工作的立場。

ex.en: Are you aware of the new employee's past work history?
ex.zh: 你知道這位新員工過去的工作經歷嗎?

note: be aware of sth 察覺到⋯
awareness 意識、察覺;unaware 不知道的

ex.en: The manager didn't have any basis for firing the employee.
ex.zh: 經理沒有任何解僱這名員工的依據。

ex.en: On the basis of my ten years of loyalty to this company, I feel that I deserve three weeks' vacation.
ex.zh: 基於我對公司十年的忠誠,我覺得自己應得三週假期。

note: on the basis of 根據⋯;on a regular basis 定期地

ex.en: Although the analyst earned a better salary at his new job, his benefits were better at his previous job.
ex.zh: 雖然這位分析師在新工作的薪水比較高,但他先前工作的福利比較好。

ex.en: We all benefit from the company's policy of semiannual reviews.
ex.zh: 公司每半年檢討一次的政策讓我們所有人都受益。

note: benefit from sth 從⋯獲益;fringe benefits 額外福利
beneficial 有益的;beneficiary 受益人

ex.en: The company compensates employees for overtime by paying double for extra hours.
ex.zh: 公司以雙倍薪資補償員工的加班時數。

ex.en: The company will compensate employees for any travel expenses.
ex.zh: 公司會補償員工的任何差旅費用。

note: compensate sb for sth 就某事補償某人

ex.en: Senior management is handling these contract negotiations delicately.
ex.zh: 高階管理層正在小心謹慎地處理這些合約談判。

ex.en: The manager delicately asked about the health of his client.
ex.zh: 經理委婉地詢問了他客戶的健康狀況。

note: handle sth delicately 謹慎處理某事
delicate 微妙的、精緻的;delicacy 微妙、美食

ex.en: Some employees may be eligible for the tuition reimbursement plan.
ex.zh: 部分員工可能有資格適用學費補助計畫。

ex.en: I don't understand why I'm not eligible if I have been with the company for over a year.
ex.zh: 我不明白,我進公司已超過一年,為什麼我沒有資格?

note: be eligible for sth / to V 有資格⋯
eligibility 資格;反義 ineligible 不合資格的

ex.en: My manager thinks flexibly, enabling herself to solve many sticky problems.
ex.zh: 我的經理思考很有彈性,因此能解決許多棘手的問題。

ex.en: We need to respond flexibly if we want to keep customers in this competitive market.
ex.zh: 如果想在這個競爭激烈的市場中留住客戶,我們必須靈活應變。

note: flexible 有彈性的;flexibility 彈性

ex.en: You must know what you want and what you can accept when you negotiate a salary.
ex.zh: 談薪水時,你必須清楚知道自己想要什麼,以及能接受什麼。

ex.en: The associate looked forward to the day that she would be able to negotiate her own contracts.
ex.zh: 這位同事期盼著有一天能自己協商合約。

note: negotiate sth 或 negotiate with sb about sth 皆可
negotiation 談判;negotiable 可協商的

ex.en: With his raise, Mr. Drvoshanov was able to afford to buy a new car.
ex.zh: 加薪之後,德沃夏諾夫先生買得起一輛新車了。

ex.en: We need to raise the standard for timeliness.
ex.zh: 我們需要提高準時的標準。

note: raise 是及物動詞(舉起);rise 是不及物動詞(上升)
美式說 raise;英式「加薪」多說 pay rise

ex.en: She retired at the age of 64 but continued to be very active with volunteer work.
ex.zh: 她六十四歲退休,但仍積極投入志工工作。

ex.en: Many people would like to win the lottery and retire.
ex.zh: 很多人都希望能中樂透然後退休。

note: retire from sth 從⋯退休;retire at the age of 在⋯歲退休

ex.en: The day that Ms. Weng became fully vested in the retirement plan, she gave her two weeks' notice.
ex.zh: 翁女士完全取得退休計畫的既得權利那天,就提出了兩週的離職通知。

ex.en: The company has a vested interest in the happiness of its employees.
ex.zh: 公司與員工的幸福有著切身的利害關係。

note: vested interest 既得利益;fully vested 完全取得權利

ex.en: Hourly wages have increased by 20 percent over the last two years.
ex.zh: 過去兩年來,時薪上漲了百分之二十。

ex.en: The intern spends more than half of her wages on rent.
ex.zh: 這名實習生把一半以上的薪水花在房租上。

note: wage 多指時薪或週薪;salary 指月薪或年薪
minimum wage 最低工資;hourly wage 時薪
